free_tier.stated: Publishing: no size restriction on published datasets ('Currently we do not impose restrictions on the size of the datasets that can be published'); the largest published datasets are about 5 TB. Accepted content is limited to natural-hazards research datasets.

per_object_cap.stated: no restriction on dataset size is imposed; the largest published datasets are about 5 TB

limits.value: publication accepts natural-hazards research datasets only, and each dataset is curated before it receives a DOI

identity_cost.detail: the sign-up form asks for an email affiliated with a trusted institution, plus institution name, country, URL and address; an institution outside the trusted list gives limited access to TACC resources and no eligibility to be a project's principal investigator (whether a limited account can publish is unverified)

reliability_note: The repository is supported by the NSF through March of 2027; TACC has formally committed to preserving published data with landing pages and DOIs indefinitely if the program ends.
confidence_note: The curation policies page and the registration page of designsafe-ci.org, re-read on 2026-11-03, state no size restriction on published datasets, the natural-hazards scope, and the trusted-institution registration notice. Whether a limited account can publish is not stated and stays unverified.
